tasks.label: Start ShopeQuick static site
tasks.command: if (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'ShopeQuick is already being served on port 8000' } else { py -m http.server 8000 --directory frontend }

background.endsPattern: Serving HTTP on|ShopeQuick is already being served
